invariants.rationale: The method expects manager to be non-null, as it is always used in subsequent loader calls.
file is used in file.extension() and usesAtlas(file), so it must be non-null.
file.extension() is used in toLowerCase(); for safety, it must be non-null.
fileName is passed to sub-loader methods; nulls could cause errors.
The file extension check splits exclusively on these possibilities.
